content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: XQL(ITDR-015 Inbound NetNTLMv2 Authentication To Rogue Responder Host) AND XQL(ITDR-015 Offline Cracking-Tool Process With Recon-Shell Causality) AND (XQL(ITDR-015 Compromised-Account Validation Across Domain Hosts) OR BIOC(ITDR-015 Compromised-Account Authentication From Attacker Foothold)) AND (XQL(ITDR-015 WinRM Remote-Shell Session Landing On Domain Host) OR BIOC(ITDR-015 WinRM Lateral Movement Landing Remote Shell)) — stitches the LLMNR/NBT-NS poisoning capture, the offline NetNTLMv2 crack on the attacker foothold, the cracked-credential validation across domain hosts, and the WinRM lateral landing into one credential-access-to-lateral-movement incident, all tied to a single attacker source_ip / recon-shell CGO.
rules.name: Internal AD Kill-Chain — Enumerate To Poison To Crack To Validate To Lateral WinRM
